newsitem.title: UK: Stagecoach up again on broker "buy" stance.
newsitem.headline: Stagecoach up again on broker "buy" stance.

text.p: Shares in Stagecoach Holdings hit another record high on Tuesday, continuing to benefit from a UBS "buy" note, dealers said.
In early trading, shares added 20p to 575p, bucking a weak UK market. The stock earlier hit a new high of 577p.
Shares in Stagecoach have risen 67 percent in 1996 and over nine percent since the note was published on Friday.

UBS, recommending the stock as a buy, said peak margins had yet to achieved in all the group's bus companies and it expected earnings to grow at more than 50 percent per annum over the next two years as it brought underperforming units to maturity.
Given the prospect for improving operating margins and growing contributions from SouthWest Trains and Porterbrook, UBS, said the discount to the market looked too low.
